name: VanillaSugar
source:
One quiet girl. One radiant soul who ignites her heart's flame.
In her desperate struggle to preserve this warmth, Mari will learn some fires consume everything they touch.

"I don't see faces. I fear them. I fear human faces."
"I never wanted this... Never wanted anyone hurt. How did it come to this?"
"Kaori-chan... my sweet Kaori-chan... How blessed I am that kind, gentle Kaori-chan hasn't abandoned me."
"Even as I lose my mind, I'm glad Kaori-chan holds my hand through it. She truly makes me happy..."

Dive into a haunting narrative where love becomes obsession, and protection twists into possession. Every choice stains your hands darker in this beautifully unsettling visual novel about the price of devotion.


This game was inspired by Yandere Simulator.

[From [url=https://j-bstrd.itch.io/vanillasugar]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位安静的女孩。一颗光芒四射的灵魂，点燃了她心中的火焰。
在拼命努力维持这种温暖的过程中，玛丽将了解到有些火会吞噬它们所接触到的一切。

“我看不到面孔。我害怕它们。我害怕人脸。”
“我从来不想这样……从来不想让任何人受伤。怎么会变成这样？”
“小香织……我可爱的小香织……我真是太幸运了，善良、温柔的小香织没有抛弃我。”
“即使我失去了理智，我也很高兴小香织能握住我的手。她真的让我很开心……”

沉浸在令人难忘的故事中，爱变成了痴迷，保护变成了占有。在这部关于奉献的代价的美丽而令人不安的视觉小说中，每一个选择都会让你的手变得更黑。


该游戏的灵感来自Yandere Simulator。

[来自[url=https://j-bstrd.itch.io/vanillasugar]Itch.io[/url]]
